h: Atiku camp calls Tinubu's 90-day cost-of-living plan "election bait"
p: Atiku's campaign has reportedly dismissed the president's 90-day plan to ease the cost of living as a pre-election move. The plan was backed by the National Economic Council a day earlier, though details have not been published. The presidency has not yet responded to the claim.
more: The National Economic Council endorsed the plan on Thursday.
Full details of the measures are yet to be released.
Tinubu's 2027 campaign has just been flagged off.
